info.description: ### API for accessing information and rich metadata for NCEI Space Weather data ### Notes - Information on each satellite and their products can be found on the associated [Web Portal](/cloud-access/space-weather-portal/). - All requests need the major version prefix (eg "v1"). Major, non-compatible changes to the API may occur that will increment the major version number. Minor changes, fixes, and enhancements to the API will increment the minor build version only and not require a URL update. - See example python plotting code using this API at the associated [Web Portal](/cloud-access/space-weather-portal/) help page. - This server supports the HAPI v3.2.0 specification for delivery of time series data. See the /hapi routes below. For more information, see the [HAPI github site](https://github.com/hapi-server/data-specification)
info.title: NCEI Space Weather Portal API

get.description:
## Notes:
- Retrieves a list of available data products, which can be filtered by a specific satellite and/or instrument.
- A product name is unique and represents a type of data file produced by an instrument.
- A product has many parameters whose values are captured in this database as time-series data accessible via the /values API route.
- Products are typically represented by data files produced at some cadence (examples: daily aggregation file, single granular file).  These files are available via the /files API route.

## Notes:
- A satellite represents a unique spacecraft name that contains one or more instruments.

## Notes
- Time column is always returned.
- Valid time formats:
  - "yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ" (Z is optional but GMT always assumed)
  - "yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss.sssZ" (Z is optional but GMT always assumed)
  - UNIX timestamp in milliseconds (e.g., 1643698800000)
- The `parameters` input uses a specific encoding format
- The `criteria` input allows for complex query conditions
- Since two products can have the same parameter name, the parameter name returned has the product name appended to the front with a dot delimiter:
  - eg: CCOR1_0B.DETTEMP

parameters.description: UTC Start time to query against. Valid formats are ISO 8601 or UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description: UTC End time to query against. Valid formats are ISO 8601 or UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.description: Encoded string defining which parameter columns to return. Format is a semicolon-separated list of colon-separated 3-tuples ([SATELLITE]:[PRODUCT]:[PARAMETER]).
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.description: Encoded string defining criteria to query against. Format is a semicolon-separated list of colon-separated tuples.
parameters.name: criteria

parameters.description: Convert flag-type values into an array of actual flag indices.
parameters.name: map_flag

parameters.description: Time column return format. Use 'ts' for UNIX timestamp in milliseconds or 'iso' for ISO 8601.  Time is converted as milliseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z and does not always reflect the native format from the associated data files.
parameters.name: time_format
